'''Andrée Ehresmann''' ([[Birth name|née]] Bastiani) (9 July 1935 – 21 August 2026) was a French mathematician who specialised in [[category theory]].<ref>{{cite web |language=fr |title=Ehresmann, Andrée (1935...) |url=http://catalogue.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/cb122843994 |website=[[catalogue.bnf.fr]] |access-date=28 February 2018}}</ref>

== Life ==
Ehresmann obtained her ''[[baccalauréat]]'' in 1952; subsequently, she studied in Marseille and Paris.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Chataur Melchio |first=David |date=21 August 2026 |title=Décès de Andrée Ehresmann |url=https://smf.emath.fr/node/3698854 |access-date=2026-08-25 |website=[[Société mathématique de France]]|trans-title=Death of Andrée Ehresmann|language=fr}}</ref>

She was a researcher at [[Centre national de la recherche scientifique|CNRS]] from 1957 to 1963. She was awarded a [[Ph.D.]] in 1962 at [[University of Paris]] under the supervision of [[Gustave Choquet]]. Her thesis was entitled ''Différentiabilité dans les espaces localement convexes. Distructures'' [Differentiability in locally convex spaces. Distructures].<ref>{{Cite web|title=sous|url=http://www-ext.impmc.upmc.fr/~brouder/bornology.html|access-date=2022-02-13|website=www-ext.impmc.upmc.fr}}</ref>

In 1967 she became a professor at [[IRCAM]], at the [[University of Picardie Jules Verne]]; after she retired, she became [[emeritus professor|emerita professor]].<ref>{{cite news|last=Ferri|first=Massimo|date=6 May 2015|title=Ircam, Parigi: un tuffo nella matemusica|language=it|trans-title=IRCAM, Paris: a dive into mathematics|website=[[Il Fatto Quotidiano]]|url=https://www.ilfattoquotidiano.it/2015/05/06/ircam-parigi-un-tuffo-nella-matemusica/1650958/|url-status=live|access-date=28 February 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150509171531/http://www.ilfattoquotidiano.it/2015/05/06/ircam-parigi-un-tuffo-nella-matemusica/1650958/|archive-date=2015-05-09}}</ref>

Ehresmann died in [[Amiens]] on 21 August 2026, at the age of 91.<ref>{{Cite news |last= |first= |date=2026-08-21 |title=Hommage à Andrée Ehresmann |url=https://carnet.courrier-picard.fr/avis-de-deces/andree-ehresmann-2026-08-21-f59558fe120617f5d18213afdc843e264610847d |access-date=2026-08-25 |publisher={{Interlanguage link|Le Courrier picard|fr}} |language=fr-FR}}</ref><ref name=":0" />
== Research ==
Ehresmann published over 100 works on Analysis (Differential Calculus and Infinite-dimensional Distributions, Guiding Systems and Optimization Problems), Category Theory (with her husband, [[Charles Ehresmann]]: sketches and internal categories, multiple categories, closed monoidal structures) and the modeling of complex autonomous systems (Memory Scalable Systems, including the MENS model for neuro-cognitive systems).

She developed, with Jean-Paul Vanbremeersch a model of Memory Evolutive Systems, which proposes a mathematical model for 'living' systems with a hierarchy of complex components with multiple temporalities, such as biological, neuro-cognitive, or social systems. Based on a theory of 'dynamic' categories, evolving memory systems can analyze complexity, emergence and self-organization.

Ehresmann was the director of the mathematical journal [[Cahiers de Topologie et Géométrie Différentielle Catégoriques]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://cahierstgdc.com/|title=cahiers de topologie et géométrie différentielle catégoriques|language=en-US|access-date=2019-07-28}}</ref>
